The clinical presentation of severe, nocturnal knee pain in a 24-year-old male, unresponsive to NSAIDs, combined with the lack of mechanical symptoms (locking/clicking) and the absence of systemic inflammatory markers suggests a locally aggressive synovial proliferation rather than septic arthritis, gout, or mechanical derangement.
